title: loops/loop.yml — per-repo facts for the loop-everything v2 hub

version.description: Contract version. This schema describes version 2.

human.description: GitHub handle to @mention on interrupts (loop-waiting / loop-needs-human / loop-ops). @mentions notify; labels don't.

required_check.description: Branch-protection check name the harness snapshots and the merge rule requires green.

branch_prefix.description: Loop branch prefix; scopes the agent token's push permission.

lanes.description: Parallel-lane policy: default when the caller doesn't say, hard cap always.

setup.description: Shell commands run in the spoke checkout before the agent starts (installs, prereq builds — e.g. Nina's pnpm install + shared package builds). The runner's toolchain must already provide the interpreters/tools these commands need.

verify.description: The verifier ladder, concretely: level -> shell command. L0 is required.

serial_paths.description: Glob list — units touching these are lane-0-only, one at a time.

require_status.description: Commit-status context substring (case-insensitive) that must be green to merge PRs touching `paths`.

blind_spots.description: Extra merge guards: CI passes but doesn't prove it (e.g. web/** needs the Vercel status; Nina #191/#195).

invariants.description: Repo 'must not break' rules, injected verbatim into the wake prompt.

network.description: Agent network policy. `none` routes web-needing units to loop-needs-human instead of shipping degraded fallbacks.

escalation.description: Optional smart-model tag-in agent and the issue label that forces the route. Omit if the repo has no escalation agent.

allowed_tools_extra.description: Extra Claude Code allowedTools entries appended to the hub base list (e.g. Bash(pnpm install:*)).

registry.description: Optional path to a loops/README.md-style registry; omit for ticket-only repos.
